Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Your Profile
You have between 3-5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform or Cloud Engineering, including experience working directly with clients.
You have hands-on experience with AWS cloud environments and their core infrastructure services.
You have experience with Terraform and practical knowledge of Ansible for Infrastructure as Code and automation.
You have hands-on experience with Docker or Podman, Kubernetes and Helm, ideally including Amazon EKS and ECR.
You have experience building and securing CI/CD and GitOps workflows, particularly with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
You understand cloud security and observability practices, including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, AWS CloudTrail, Prometheus and Grafana.
You have practical experience using AI-powered developer tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer or equivalent, to support engineering, automation and code quality.
You communicate confidently in professional English, can explain technical topics to both technical and business stakeholders, and are willing to travel occasionally to client sites.
 Nice-to-have
Recent hands-on project experience requiring Java knowledge.
 Your Responsibilities
 As part of our Cloud and DevOps consulting team, you will help clients design, build and operate secure, scalable and cost-efficient cloud platforms, with a strong focus on AWS. You will combine hands-on engineering with direct client interaction, supporting projects from technical discovery and solution design through implementation and operation.
You design, build and operate secure and scalable cloud infrastructure and platform services, primarily on AWS, using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible.
You deploy and operate containerized and cloud-native workloads using Docker/Podman, Kubernetes and Helm, including technologies such as Amazon EKS and ECR.
You build and secure CI/CD and GitOps workflows using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD, integrating IAM, RBAC and secrets management throughout the delivery lifecycle.
You establish reliable cloud operations through monitoring, observability and auditing using AWS CloudTrail, Prometheus and Grafana.
You work directly with clients from technical discovery and solution design through hands-on implementation, using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer to improve automation, code quality and delivery efficiency.
 Your Benefits
Career model: For us, a career that is individually tailored to your needs means individual development opportunities in line with your vision and at your pace. Our PERSONAL GROWTH MODEL supports you in this, whether as an expert or entrepreneur
Continuing education: Let's grow together! Stay up to date with over 200 training days per year in our Academy, or continue your education through certification courses
German classes: We encourage you to learn a new language, as it will be useful for you in your career development
Leadership culture: Respect, appreciation, and the highest level of expertise are the key elements of our "Coaching & Leading" leadership model. This means that your individual goals and Wavestone corporate goals are perfectly aligned
Mobile Work: Flexible, mobile working is part of our DNA. With our Mobile Work Policy, we offer you the right framework to work remotely. Plus, via our offices, we offer attractive contact points for personal exchange
Me-Time: We provide tailored vacation days, that will be increased every year (max. 30 days) based on your seniority within the company, as well as flexible working hours. Because life next to Wavestone also counts for us
Private Health Insurance: You are important to us; such is your health. We provide you with the appropriate framework that covers the essential health benefits needed to maintain your health
Multi-benefits Platform: As flexibility is in our DNA, it also translates into our benefits. You have the option to decide how to spend funds allocated for monthly benefits depending on your needs (meal tickets, gift vouchers, cultural vouchers, holiday vouchers and even subscriptions to sports clubs)
Mindfulness & Health: The Mindfulness Community offers mindfulness training and regular exchange
Events: Numerous events for networking and celebrating are simply part of our Wavestone life
